source_conflict_analysis.analysis: The command combines a nominal three-second duration with `--run_infinitely`, leaving process termination and effective run semantics contradictory. Endpoint placeholders and OpenSM ownership are gaps, but the duration/infinite lifecycle is an actionable source conflict.

blocked_analysis.analysis: Topology, lifecycle and thresholds can be supplied/resolved; the intended IB bandwidth test is identifiable.

engineering_decision_pending.question: Resolve Performance row47 Wistron-Performance Networking-00001-V004: define DUT/peer HCA BDF/device/port/GUID/GID/LID/IP roles and OpenSM ownership; reconcile `-D 3` with `--run_infinitely` and approve tracked server/client cleanup, CPU30/q2/port11000/profile/isolation; define the98% bandwidth denominator/tolerance plus IB counter, system-health, abort and recovery rules.

review_improvement: Preserves all concrete source parameters while converting ambiguous placeholders and an unbounded lifecycle into an attributable, recoverable two-endpoint test.
independent_technical_reasoning: ib_write_bw requires complementary endpoints and a valid fabric route; HCA names and IPs do not prove the intended physical port. An infinite server can outlive a three-second client and affect later tests. Queue depth, CPU/NUMA placement and link overhead materially change the ratio to specification, so the98% verdict needs a defined denominator and complete two-side evidence.
